title: Project Zomboid workshop.txt
description: Read as key=value. Parameters from the PZwiki workshop.txt page (last updated for 42.5.1): version stays 1; id is the Workshop ID, or absent to create a new item; description may repeat, one line per parameter; tags are semicolon-separated; visibility is documented as 0 to 3. This repo's files use workshopid=0 and visibility=public from the vendored community guide, so both are accepted here and the difference is recorded in the repo's conventions.
